name: [🎉RELEASE] Anime Siege
desc:
Welcome to Anime Siege!

💥Anime Siege is a tower defense game on the Roblox platform that brings together a vast roster of iconic anime characters to battle against waves of enemies 🗡️ ! 

⚔️ Summon powerful units to fight back against relentless enemies!
📈 Upgrade and evolve your characters to unlock their true potential!
🏰 Conquer all the different realms and become the greatest Sieger !
👥 Team up with friends and conquer challenging game modes together!

Your base is the last line of defense. Will you rise and protect the realms from destruction?
🔥 Play Anime Siege now and join the battle! 🔥
